finding.title: The `deposit` method does not validate the input `amount`.
The `deductFees` method is private, which is good, but there is no mechanism to ensure that fees are deducted correctly or prevent unauthorized access to this method.
There is no logging or monitoring of transactions.

scan_orig.message: The class 'BankAccount' does not declare a constructor although it has private member variables which likely require initialization.
Technically the member function 'BankAccount::deductFees' can be static (but you may consider moving to unnamed namespace).
Technically the member function 'BankAccount::getBalance' can be const.
